author: GitHub
description:
The GitHub shop is officially launching its new spring 2026 collection, and it is built for wherever developers end up, not just sitting at a desk. In this short, we share a quick look at some of our favorite new samples, from classic slides and t-shirts to stylish navy blue hats. We even have matching hoodies and floating koozies to level up your spring gear. Head over to the site to see the full collection live today: https://thegithubshop.com/

#GitHubShop #SpringCollection #Mona
